codeSnippets.description: Generic ConflictResolver base class for reconciling local Drift SQLite data with remote API models
Sync service pending queue processor with automatic rollback on error

considerations: Pending queue must be FIFO to maintain correct sequence of financial transactions
Balance compensation must rollback immediately when offline submission fails at remote backend
Connectivity stream must be disposed on service close to prevent memory leaks
keyImplementationPoints: Drift SQLite table for pending transfers acting as persistent offline queue
Reactive Connectivity listener triggers automatic sync when device transitions from offline to online
Server-Wins and timestamp-based conflict reconciliation via generic ConflictResolver abstraction
Optimistic balance mutation with automatic rollback on server rejection
patterns.overview:
Pola arsitektur offline-first untuk transaksi finansial mobile menggunakan local SQLite queue, pendeteksi konektivitas reaktif, dan strategi rekonsiliasi data (conflict resolution) dengan rollback otomatis pada kegagalan.

```text
[User Action / Transfer] ────(Offline)────► [Insert PendingTransfers Table]
        │                                             │
     (Online)                                         ▼
        │                                   [Optimistic Local Balance]
        ▼                                             │
[Submit Remote API] ◄──(Connectivity Resumed)─────────┘
        ├─► (Success) ──► Mark 'synced' + Insert Transactions Table
        └─► (Failure) ──► Mark 'failed' + Rollback Balance + Notify User
```
patterns.purpose: Memastikan aplikasi mobile tetap dapat melakukan transaksi dan perubahan data saat tidak ada koneksi internet, lalu secara otomatis menyinkronkan data dengan rekonsiliasi konflik saat online.
patterns.summary: Offline-First Synchronization & Queue Conflict Resolver pattern in Flutter with Drift SQLite and ConnectivityPlus.
patterns.title: Offline-First Synchronization & Queue Conflict Resolver

codeSnippets.description: Repository layer providing clean domain interface combining local drift stream and remote operations
Feature binding using GetX lazyPut to instantiate dependencies on demand

considerations: Keep presentation layer decoupled from direct database or HTTP queries by using Repository as gateway
Use lazy bindings to avoid unnecessary memory overhead on app boot
Maintain unidirectional data flow from repository stream to controller to UI widget
keyImplementationPoints: Feature-first folder structure isolating data, presentation, and bindings per domain feature
GetX Bindings for lazy dependency injection on route navigation
Repository pattern acting as single source of truth mediating between local and remote datasources
Reactive streaming using Drift watch streams piped into GetX observables
patterns.overview:
Pola modularitas codebase Flutter berbasis fitur (Feature-First) yang memisahkan tanggung jawab ke dalam layer Data (Datasource & Repository), Presentation (Controller & UI), dan Dependency Injection (Bindings).

```text
[Page / Widget View] ◄───(GetX Obx / Watch Stream)──── [Feature Controller]
        │                                                      │
        ▼ (UI Event)                                           ▼
[Controller Method] ─────────(Calls)───────────► [Feature Repository]
                                                               │
                                       ┌───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
                                       ▼                                               ▼
                         [Local Datasource (Drift)]                       [Remote Datasource (Dio)]
```
patterns.purpose: Menyediakan struktur modular yang scalable dan mudah di-maintain untuk aplikasi mobile skala menengah hingga besar dengan isolasi dependensi per-fitur.
patterns.summary: Feature-First Clean Modular Architecture with Reactive State Binding using GetX and Drift in Flutter.
patterns.title: Feature-First Clean Modular Architecture with Reactive Bindings

codeSnippets.description: Biometric authentication controller with PIN verification and session gate

considerations: Clear PIN buffer memory immediately after verification to avoid memory extraction risks
Configure persistAcrossBackgrounding to prevent race conditions when OS biometric dialog pops up
Ensure offAllNamed is used upon login to wipe the authentication route stack
keyImplementationPoints: Hardware biometric authentication via local_auth with biometricOnly policy
Custom 6-digit numeric PIN fallback with creation and 2-step confirmation validation
Persistent session authentication gate stored securely in local settings storage
Navigation offAllNamed to prevent user from popping back into auth screens
patterns.overview:
Pola autentikasi lokal multi-tier untuk aplikasi perbankan/fintech yang memprioritaskan autentikasi biometrik perangkat keras (FaceID / Fingerprint) dengan fallback keypad PIN 6-digit terenkripsi dan proteksi backgrounding.

```text
[App Launch / Protected Route]
             │
             ▼
   [Check Device Biometrics] ───(Supported & Enabled)───► [Prompt Biometric (Fingerprint/FaceID)]
             │                                                          │
      (Not Supported)                                      ┌────────────┴────────────┐
             │                                             ▼ (Success)               ▼ (Fail / Cancel)
             ▼                                      [Grant Session]           [Switch to PIN Fallback]
   [6-Digit PIN Keypad] ◄────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
patterns.purpose: Memberikan keamanan otentikasi cepat (biometrik) dengan proteksi fallback andal (PIN 6-digit) untuk aplikasi finansial mobile.
patterns.summary: Biometric-First Local Auth & Fallback PIN Session Gate pattern in Flutter.
patterns.title: Biometric-First Local Auth & Fallback PIN Session Gate

codeSnippets.description: Centralized Dio HTTP client wrapper with configured interceptor pipeline and timeouts
Standardized typed domain error data model

considerations: Configure aggressive connect and receive timeouts to prevent hanging sockets on weak cellular networks
Normalize non-standard backend error bodies into consistent typed ErrorData
keyImplementationPoints: Centralized Dio client with standard headers and timeout configuration
Interceptors pipeline for logging and intercepting HTTP error responses
Typed domain error modeling (ErrorData) decoupling presentation from raw DioException
patterns.overview:
Pola abstraksi klien HTTP menggunakan Dio dengan pipeline interceptors untuk logging, normalisasi respons error backend menjadi model domain ErrorData(code, message), dan isolasi kegagalan request.

```text
[Datasource HTTP Request] ──► [Dio BaseOptions] ──► [Interceptors Pipeline]
                                                             │
                                       ┌─────────────────────┴─────────────────────┐
                                       ▼ (HTTP 2xx)                                ▼ (HTTP 4xx / 5xx)
                              [Return Domain Model]                      [Map to Typed ErrorData]
```
patterns.purpose: Menyediakan lapisan komunikasi HTTP yang konsisten, terisolasi, dan aman dengan penanganan domain error yang terstandarisasi.
patterns.summary: Resilient HTTP Client & Domain Error Handling Architecture with Dio and ErrorData in Flutter.
patterns.title: Resilient HTTP Client & Domain Error Handling Architecture
